edges.subject: UniProtKB:Q9X5C9
edges.description: The native QsuD complex contains two identical ATCC 13032 subunits; composition is not independent catalytic attribution to the monomer.

evidence.source_assertion: CPLX-7981 contains two copies of MONOMER-15330.
MONOMER-15330 has a UNIPROT unification link to Q9X5C9, belongs to CPLX-7981 and links gene G-11733.
G-11733 qsuD has accession-1 Cgl0424 and product MONOMER-15330; this is distinct from the R-strain locus cgR_0495.
The issuing Q9X5C9 record identifies Corynebacterium glutamicum ATCC 13032, NCBITaxon196627, and locus Cgl0424.

edges.subject: MetaCyc:CPLX-7981
edges.description: QsuD catalyzes NAD-dependent shikimate oxidation. Native substrate Km is 46.6 mM. The curated complex comment reports NAD preference and >300-fold lower turnover with NADP; preference is not complete absence of NADP activity. The root chemistry audit verifies exact RXN-20484/RHEA:17742 molecular equivalence.

evidence.source_assertion: ENZRXN-17383 assigns CPLX-7981 to RXN-20484 with EV-EXP-IDA-PURIFIED-PROTEIN-HH and PMID18566515. Its separate PMID19376919 mutant evidence concerns strain R and is not merged into this purified ATCC 13032 claim.
RXN-20484 consumes shikimate and NAD, producing 3-dehydroshikimate, NADH and a proton. Its native direction is PHYSIOL-LEFT-TO-RIGHT and PWY-6419 is its named pathway.
The native shikimate Km entry is 46600 micromolar, citing PMID18566515. This value is a curated native annotation rather than a new measurement.
The native complex comment describes a homodimer, lower Km for quinate than shikimate, >3-fold greater catalytic efficiency for quinate, and >300-fold lower turnover with NADP than NAD.

endpoint_qualifiers.description: Recombinant ATCC 13032 QsuD homodimer preparation. The associated 2NLO structural sample has a 19-residue N-terminal extension containing His6; cleavage state across all kinetic preparations was not independently verified.

evidence.source_assertion: ENZRXN-17383 assigns CPLX-7981 to RXN-20484 with EV-EXP-IDA-PURIFIED-PROTEIN-HH and PMID18566515. Its separate PMID19376919 mutant evidence concerns strain R and is not merged into this purified ATCC 13032 claim.

2NLO entity 1 is an N-tagged wild-type Cgl0424 sample from ATCC 13032, expressed in BL21(DE3) from pETNHis. Its sequence is exactly the 19-residue extension MSGHHHHHHGSEQLYFQGA plus the complete 283-residue Q9X5C9.

edges.subject: NCBIProtein:BAF53460.1
edges.description: The R-strain QsuB role is inferred from operon membership, sequence similarity and induction in the 2009 evidence. No purified R-QsuB assay is claimed; the ATCC 13869 QsuB assay is a different protein/strain context.

evidence.source_assertion: The qsuB product in strain R was uncharacterized: operon context, N-terminal 25% identity to fungal DHS dehydratases and induction support an inferred role. C-terminal HPPD similarity does not establish dioxygenase activity.
ENZRXN-17385 links MONOMER-15334 to DHSHIKIMATE-DEHYDRO-RXN with EV-EXP-IGI and PMID19376919.
G-11737 is qsuB, accession-1 cgR_0493, with product MONOMER-15334. This correct R-strain locus replaces the PWY-6419 narrative error linking fungal qutB/G-11736.

edges.subject: UniProtKB:A4QH18
edges.description: Issuing UniProt places the R-strain ShiA protein at the cell membrane; the separate multipass topology prediction remains an inference, not an independently demonstrated topology. This is location of the transporter rather than location of the full catabolic pathway.

evidence.source_assertion: A4QH18 SUBCELLULAR LOCATION identifies cell membrane with ECO:0000269/PMID25406451; its GO cross-reference is GO:0005886, plasma membrane. Multipass topology has ECO:0000255.

edges.subject: RHEA:24849
edges.description: The terminal dehydration supplies protocatechuate to the explicitly linked downstream ortho-cleavage pathway. This interface does not add the downstream reactions as formal shikimate-II members or assert whole-route activity in every downstream-pathway organism.

evidence.source_assertion: PWY-6419 links its terminal protocatechuate product to PROTOCATECHUATE-ORTHO-CLEAVAGE-PWY. The pathway comment identifies protocatechuate as the two-step route endpoint and a substrate for downstream mineralization.
The downstream pathway begins with PROTOCATECHUATE-34-DIOXYGENASE-RXN consuming 3-4-DIHYDROXYBENZOATE; its common name is protocatechuate degradation II (ortho-cleavage pathway).

explicit_boundaries: QsuD native G-11733 is ATCC 13032, not the R gene transcription target.
R QsuB is a qualified inferred assignment, not the ATCC 13869 purified assay.
ShiA/R and QsuR/A/B/D transcriptional mechanisms are supplied by primary proposals with exact gene endpoints.
UniProt formal H+-symport RHEA28973 is ECO0000305 curator inference; not copied as an experimentally measured proton stoichiometry.
ShiR promoter binding in UniProt is structured experimental annotation; primary abstract does not identify binding construct, so no unqualified direct binding edge proposed from abstract alone.
